hero.heading: Aviation Sectors We Serve
hero.body: AeroExpert works with a broad range of aviation organisations — from major commercial airlines and international airports to MRO providers, aviation authorities and technology vendors. Our consulting services are tailored to the specific requirements of each sector.

sectors.title: Commercial Airlines
sectors.description: Full-service and low-cost carriers seeking to modernise systems, improve operational efficiency and drive digital transformation across commercial and operational functions.

sectors.title: Regional Airlines
sectors.description: Regional and commuter operators requiring cost-effective technology solutions and practical advisory support tailored to smaller-scale operations.

sectors.title: Cargo Airlines
sectors.description: Cargo carriers and integrators seeking to optimise cargo management systems, operational technology and digital capabilities.

sectors.title: Charter Operators
sectors.description: Charter and non-scheduled operators requiring flexible technology solutions and advisory support for their specific operational model.

sectors.title: Business Aviation
sectors.description: Business aviation operators and management companies seeking technology solutions appropriate to their scale and operational requirements.

sectors.title: Airports
sectors.description: Airport operators seeking to modernise passenger processing systems, improve operational efficiency and deliver digital transformation programmes.

sectors.title: Ground Handling Companies
sectors.description: Ground handlers requiring technology advisory support for passenger handling systems, operational platforms and digital transformation.

sectors.title: Aviation Authorities
sectors.description: Civil aviation authorities and regulatory bodies requiring technology advisory support for oversight systems and digital transformation.

sectors.title: MRO Organisations
sectors.description: Maintenance, repair and overhaul organisations seeking to modernise maintenance information systems and operational technology.

sectors.title: Flight Training Organisations
sectors.description: Flight training organisations and aviation academies requiring technology advisory support for training management and operational systems.

sectors.title: Aviation Technology Providers
sectors.description: Aviation technology vendors and system integrators requiring independent advisory support for product development, market positioning and customer engagement.
